_comment: Ratchet for scripts/i18n-tools/ui-label-audit.test.ts. defects: {key: [problems() reason stems]} known in messages/<loc>.json; variants: {short English label: why it may have >1 translation}. A new defect or variant fails the test, and so does an entry that no longer occurs: run `node scripts/i18n-tools/ui-label-audit.mjs all --prune` after fixing. A locale audit ends with its defects empty and every variant given a reason.

variants.anomaly: fly_event_anomaly is pinned in _permanent (event id shown as-is)
variants.cancelled: a program is eingestellt; a mission or launch is abgesagt
variants.constellations: Sternbilder are star patterns; Satellitenkonstellationen are satellite fleets (Starlink etc.)
variants.detail: Details is a panel tab; DETAIL is a map zoom layer next to REGIONAL
variants.diameter: Durchm. is the abbreviated form for the narrow scan readout

variants.next: Weiter steps through a list; Nächstes is the next flight event in the HUD

variants.primary: different senses: the central body of an orbit vs the primary source of a launch record
variants.retired: ausgemustert for vehicles and stations; stillgelegt for surface sites and landers that were shut down

variants.stations: Raumstationen in the AR layer list; the 2D/3D layer toggle is a narrow chip and the context already says space
